consumerRequirements: The package exports raw TSX source. @solidjs/vite-plugin compiles it from node_modules.
Components import the package's own @/ alias; vite.shared.ts maps @/ to the package src directory.

Its @kobalte/core dependency retains the upstream file:../../vendor specifier. The application directly pins the derived Kobalte archive and overrides the UI dependency with that exact pin, resolving the relative archive from the application root.
Tailwind classes are found by explicit @source paths into the package in src/styles/*.css.
Only the barrel is exported. src/ui.ts imports the three modules used by path through @/, so the barrel's other modules and their assets are never loaded.

patches.purpose: Match Solid rc.21 DOM attribute typing for Dialog, AlertDialog and Sheet close controls without changing rendered markup.
Keep the ActionMenu Open catalog story direction-aware and ensure its modal menu closes before the accessibility scan.
Give the open ActionMenu state its own accessibility audit instead of testing only the settled page.
Keep the settled-state ActionMenu test covering focus return and restoration of the page after modal hiding.
Expose the selected value or placeholder in the select accessible name while supporting a visible field label.
Name mobile option-select triggers from their visible content and align interaction assertions with the responsive control that is actually visible.
Correct story-only geometry and direction assertions for Sheet, Tooltip, FormLayout and MultiCombobox.
Wait for initial Cancel focus in Dialog Default using the existing bounded wait while preserving the keyboard cycle and focus-return assertions.
Expose the visible formatted like count in the Like and Unlike button names while preserving pressed state and verifying missing, zero and singular counts.
Expose CommentPill and RewardPill visible counts outside parentheses in accessible names while preserving singular activity copy.
Include the visible PIRATE brand in the home control name and align notification and chat accessible names with their capped visible badges while retaining exact totals as descriptions.
Keep the desktop overflow-chat fixture on the desktop header branch at narrow audit widths.
Center fixed-width Scrubber, Waveform and CopyField story frames inside the fullscreen catalog viewport using the same one-rem gutter model as the board assertions.
Keep desktop Sidebar assertions intact while phone stories open the sheet, verify Escape focus return, and assert the visible VerticalFeed caption copy.
Account for the focus trap restoring focus after the sheet leaves the document rather than in the same frame.

patches.purpose: Preserve Escape dismissal and focus return when rc.21 attaches a dialog ref after onSettled.
Make modal menu backgrounds inert as well as aria-hidden so hidden focusable controls leave keyboard and assistive-technology reach.
Make modal dialog and sheet backgrounds inert so hidden controls cannot receive programmatic focus.
Allow slider keyboard and pointer input after Solid 2 registers thumbs in the DOM collection; the previous one-time settled read could retain index -1 and leave thumbs uneditable.
Return focus to the original opener for externally controlled modal sheets that do not render a Kobalte Dialog.Trigger.
